svg.text: PRISMA 2020 flow: prevalence, exposure and concentration of misinformation
Counts from the released dataset; primary searches run 20 to 24 June 2026, top-up searches September 2026
Records identified from databases (n = 30,958)
Scopus 20,344 · OpenAlex keyword 4,822 · PubMed 410 · OpenAlex
behavioural and preprint-venue query 5,382 (September 2026)
Databases: OpenAlex keyword and PubMed, screened in
their own stream (n = 5,232)
5,005 excluded at screening, 227 adjudicated, 19 included; 22
further OpenAlex records staged for retrieval.
41 advance to retrieval
Databases: September behavioural and preprint-venue query,
screened in its own stream (n = 5,382)
499 duplicates removed, 4,883 unique; 4,321 excluded at title;

188 advance to retrieval (89 assessed at full text, 99 not

Other methods: OpenAlex citation snowballing (n = 1,822)
backward and forward citations of 224 core studies; 1,818
candidates screened, 1,487 excluded.
331 advance to full-text retrieval, of which 19 carry a terminal
state in the record ledger and 312 do not (see the note below)
Other methods: corpus repair (n = 18,703)
this review’s own 17,583 title-stage and 1,120 abstract-stage
exclusions, re-screened under corrected criteria by two
independent model families; 335 papers retrieved and screened
at full text, 208 eligible, 127 excluded.
147 of the 208 carried a main-pool estimate at the repair’s own
freeze; 131 survive in the current freeze and carry a terminal
state, 204 do not (see the note below)
Other methods: Google Scholar recall check
a hand-run probe of the primary query’s recall rather than a
search arm; 5 studies held

Reports assessed for eligibility (n = 1,000)
Reports excluded (n = 506)
· No qualifying estimate at full text: no denominator, curated sample, wrong construct, or secondary source (n = 153)
· Not eligible on full-text re-reading: wrong construct, no denominator, or not empirical (n = 118)
· No qualifying estimate at the second full-text extraction, or a duplicate of a counted record (n = 74)
· Not a prevalence or exposure estimate (n = 48)
· Duplicate of an included record (n = 23)
· Off-topic on the title, with no retrievable full text (n = 14)
· Out of scope: producer-side, curated or secondary, not audience consumption (n = 6)
· Not eligible on full-text reading: no qualifying estimate (n = 3)
· Duplicate publication of an included record (n = 1)
· Not eligible on full-text reading: no falsity coding, stance not falsity, or no numeric estimate (n = 61)
· Extracted, then excluded: quality-only, value not printed by the study, or unreliable tables (n = 5)
Included, but contributed no codeable estimate (n = 51)
Studies included in the review (n = 443)
contributing 1,048 estimates
Identification
Screening
Included
Reports sought for retrieval = 443 included + 145 not retrieved + 51 without a codeable estimate + 506 excluded = 1,145.

Note. The citation-snowballing and corpus-repair arms ran their own full-text screens, and their per-record outcomes are held in the arm ledgers rather than in the record ledger reconciled here; only their retained

studies carry a terminal state. 312 snowballed records and 204 repaired records therefore sit outside every total below the retrieval box. The repair’s 208 eligible papers and the 51 reports without a codeable
estimate are different quantities and do not subtract: the repair’s non-pooled papers yielded estimates that the author’s class-level rulings sent to the appendix pool.

The abstract-stage screen file records 1,120 exclusions and the stage-5 file 190. 2 of the 1,120 are records the title screen did not advance, so the spine’s resolved exclusion count is 1,308 rather than 1,310.
